provenance: The Old Print Shop, New York |  | In 1916, Sargent met Thomas Eugene McKeller (1890–1962), a Black elevator attendant at Boston's Hotel Vendome. Sargent was taken with the young man's beauty, and selected him as the model for most of the figures (male and female) in his murals for the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston. To celebrate the murals' completion, a preparatory drawing of  McKeller that Sargent had given to Mrs. Gardner was selected for reproduction by the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston, to be sold as a keepsake of the project.
